askCmdr.title: Ask Cmdr

@askCmdr.title.sameAsSourceJustification: Product name of the built-in AI panel, built on the brand word 「Cmdr」 which is do-not-translate; Chinese doesn't inflect, so the name stays bare. Kept verbatim to match the `zh` catalog, `menu.view.askCmdr`, and `commands.askCmdrToggle.label`, which all carry the same justification. Every other key in this file that MENTIONS the name (`askCmdr.close`) is translated around it.
